description: Region-pinned deploy of the changed assistant image + both CDK stacks, then live verification of order placement, persistence, status lifecycle, and the recent-orders panel against the deployed CloudFront URL. Depends on FEAT-001/002/003 being complete and locally verified. Because app/assistant/** changed, the assistant container image MUST be rebuilt+pushed to ECR BEFORE cdk deploy, and the SecurityData (GSI) stack deployed before the AppEdgeAI stack. DO NOT run destroy.sh and DO NOT commit. See design.md sections (deploy sequence) and the task deploy/verification checklist.
steps: Confirm local verification is green first: from the demo root run python3 -m py_compile $(find app -name '*.py'); python3 -m pytest app/tests -q; (cd infra && npx tsc --noEmit); (cd infra && npm test, treating the one pre-existing ModelInvocationLoggingConfiguration failure as expected). Do not proceed to AWS calls if any NEW failure exists.

Resolve the account id (aws sts get-caller-identity) and log in to ECR, then rebuild+push the assistant image (because app/assistant/** changed): BUILDX_NO_DEFAULT_ATTESTATIONS=1 docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 --provenance=false --sbom=false --push -t <ACCOUNT>.dkr.ecr.ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com/session5-secure-assistant:latest ./app  (run from the demo root; ECR login: aws ecr get-login-password --region ap-southeast-1 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin <ACCOUNT>.dkr.ecr.ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com).

Deploy the GSI first: cd infra && AWS_REGION=ap-southeast-1 AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=ap-southeast-1 CDK_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT=<ACCOUNT> CDK_DEFAULT_REGION=ap-southeast-1 npx cdk deploy SecureAssistantSecurityData --require-approval never. Wait for the byCreatedAt GSI to report ACTIVE (aws dynamodb describe-table --table-name <orders-table> --region ap-southeast-1, GlobalSecondaryIndexes[].IndexStatus==ACTIVE).

Deploy the app/edge stack: cd infra && AWS_REGION=ap-southeast-1 AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=ap-southeast-1 CDK_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT=<ACCOUNT> CDK_DEFAULT_REGION=ap-southeast-1 npx cdk deploy SecureAssistantAppEdgeAI --require-approval never. This creates the OrdersListFn + GET /api/orders route.

Confirm/force the assistant Lambda to the newly pushed image digest: find the assistant function name (aws lambda list-functions or the stack resources), compare its CodeImageUri/digest to the pushed :latest digest (aws ecr describe-images --repository-name session5-secure-assistant --region ap-southeast-1), and if it did not roll, run aws lambda update-function-code --function-name <assistant-fn> --image-uri <ACCOUNT>.dkr.ecr.ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com/session5-secure-assistant@<digest> --region ap-southeast-1, then wait for LastUpdateStatus Successful.

If the deployed seed predates FEAT-002's deploy.sh change (older items lack gsiPk and so won't appear in the GSI), re-seed the two demo orders with the corrected payloads (the exact put-item JSON from FEAT-002 / design.md 11.4, computing NOW=$(date +%s)) against the live Orders table in ap-southeast-1, so the panel shows the two baseline orders. Do not run the full deploy.sh for this; issue the two aws dynamodb put-item calls directly.

Live verification against https://d1o0u6nv8iqp83.cloudfront.net and same-origin /api/*: (a) GET https://d1o0u6nv8iqp83.cloudfront.net/api/orders returns the two seeded orders newest-first with totals 9.50 then 7.50 and derived statuses (ORD-000456 PREPARING, ORD-000123 READY given the NOW-30/NOW-90 ages); (b) load the SPA and confirm the Recent Orders panel renders and refreshes (~10s); (c) place an order via the chat ('2x Latte, 1x Croissant'), confirm the reply, a placedOrder envelope on /api/chat, an immediate panel refresh, and a new RECEIVED row that advances RECEIVED->PREPARING->READY with age; (d) look that order id up via chat and confirm the returned status; (e) exercise the existing refund (PENDING->Confirm) and receipt-download flows and confirm they still work; (f) confirm all browser calls are same-origin relative /api/...
Record evidence in this FEAT's findings: the /api/orders JSON, the placed order id, the observed status transitions, and confirmation the GSI is ACTIVE and the assistant image digest matches.
acceptance_criteria: The assistant image was rebuilt+pushed BEFORE cdk; SecureAssistantSecurityData then SecureAssistantAppEdgeAI both reach UPDATE_COMPLETE in ap-southeast-1 with --require-approval never.
The byCreatedAt GSI reports IndexStatus ACTIVE and the assistant Lambda runs the newly pushed image digest.

GET /api/orders returns up to 10 orders newest-first with corrected totals and derived statuses; a chat-placed order persists, appears in the panel immediately, and advances status with age; look-up returns the order's status; refund + receipt flows still work; all calls are same-origin.
destroy.sh was NOT run and NO commit was made.

HARD INVARIANTS preserved end-to-end: region pinned ap-southeast-1, no model-id change, no weakening of Guardrail/WAF/KMS/PrivateLink/TLS, least-privilege read-only orders Lambda, side-channel ids, server-side totals, same-origin SPA.
verification: curl -s https://d1o0u6nv8iqp83.cloudfront.net/api/orders  (two seeded orders, newest-first, totals 9.50 then 7.50, derived statuses)
Manual browser pass of the SPA: panel renders+polls, chat places an order, immediate refresh, status advances; refund+receipt flows still work; all calls same-origin.
findings:
FEAT-004 deployed and live-verified in ap-southeast-1 (account 875692608981) on 2026-10-02. NO destroy.sh run, NO commit made.

LOCAL VERIFICATION (green, re-confirmed): py_compile clean; pytest app/tests = 39 passed; (cd infra && npx tsc --noEmit) clean; (cd infra && npm test) = only the known-expected AWS::Bedrock::ModelInvocationLoggingConfiguration assertion FAILED (pre-existing/out-of-scope), all other assertions ok including 'Orders table has the byCreatedAt GSI' and 'API Gateway has an orders resource with a GET method'. No NEW failures.

IMAGE REBUILD+PUSH (before cdk): assistant image rebuilt with BUILDX_NO_DEFAULT_ATTESTATIONS=1 docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 --provenance=false --sbom=false --push ./app. Old :latest digest sha256:52485f46337bba12f9fb2b46fc81d6bfa1d34797507a1b88124244779e80b227 -> new :latest digest sha256:dac3a7316f47ce000a14e0e927509e80e407c0434f115cac708a4da569aba7fb.

DEPLOY (GSI first, then app/edge): SecureAssistantSecurityData -> UPDATE_COMPLETE; byCreatedAt GSI reached IndexStatus=ACTIVE (polled CREATING->ACTIVE). SecureAssistantAppEdgeAI -> UPDATE_COMPLETE (created OrdersListFn + GET /api/orders). Orders table: SecureAssistantSecurityData-OrdersTable315BB997-1H96W1XFN3IU2.

ASSISTANT IMAGE ROLL: CDK references the :latest tag so the function still resolved the OLD digest after deploy; forced via aws lambda update-function-code --image-uri ...@sha256:dac3a73... Confirmed Code.ResolvedImageUri = sha256:dac3a7316f47ce000a14e0e927509e80e407c0434f115cac708a4da569aba7fb, State=Active, LastUpdateStatus=Successful.

RE-SEED: live seed predated the FEAT-002 deploy.sh change (old items had wrong totals 12.5/9 and lacked gsiPk/createdAt/status, so GET /api/orders returned {"orders": []}). Re-seeded the two demo orders directly (two put-item calls, NOW=$(date +%s)): ORD-000123 total 7.50 createdAt NOW-90, ORD-000456 total 9.50 createdAt NOW-30, both gsiPk=ORDER status=RECEIVED.

LIVE VERIFICATION against https://d1o0u6nv8iqp83.cloudfront.net and same-origin /api/*:
(a) GET /api/orders (post-seed): {"orders": [{"orderId": "ORD-000456", "summary": "2x Latte", "total": 9.5, "status": "PREPARING", "createdAt": 1790919270}, {"orderId": "ORD-000123", "summary": "1x Flat White, 1x Croissant", "total": 7.5, "status": "READY", "createdAt": 1790919210}]} -- newest-first, corrected totals 9.50 then 7.50, derived statuses correct (thresholds PREPARING_AFTER=20s, READY_AFTER=60s).
(b) SPA served (HTTP 200 text/html) with <section id=recent>, <ul id=recentOrders>, and orders.js (HTTP 200) which polls same-origin /api/orders every 10s and renders via textContent/createElement only.
(c) PLACED ORDER via POST /api/chat ('2x Latte and 1x Croissant'): response reply + placedOrder envelope {"orderId": "ORD-938274", "summary": "2x Latte, 1x Croissant", "total": 12.5, "status": "RECEIVED"} (server-side total 2x4.75+3.00=12.50). Immediately appeared newest-first in GET /api/orders as RECEIVED. STATUS TRANSITIONS observed over time (createdAt 1790919328): RECEIVED -> PREPARING (~t+12s) -> READY (~t+48s).
(d) LOOK-UP via POST /api/chat ('status of ORD-938274'): assistant replied the order is READY with 2 Lattes + 1 Croissant, total $12.50 -- matches the derived status.
(e) REFUND flow: POST /api/chat initiated a refund of $7.50 for ORD-000123 -> pendingRefund envelope {token: 6e08fd9c-9a44-41ec-9594-2e079acd073f, amountMasked: 7.50, orderMasked: ORD-000123} (no money moved); POST /api/refunds/confirm {token} -> {"status": "CONFIRMED"}. RECEIPT flow: GET /api/receipts/ORD-000123/url -> short-lived presigned S3 URL (expiresIn 900, HTTPS/TLS). Both still work.
(f) All browser calls are same-origin relative /api/... (confirmed in spa/app.js and spa/orders.js: /api/chat, /api/orders, /api/refunds/confirm, /api/receipts/{id}/url). No cross-origin, no API keys in the browser.

HARD INVARIANTS preserved: region pinned ap-southeast-1 everywhere (assistant env AWS_REGION_PINNED=ap-southeast-1, orders Lambda env AWS_REGION_PINNED=ap-southeast-1); model-id UNCHANGED (NOVA_MODEL_ID=apac.amazon.nova-micro-v1:0); no weakening of Guardrail/WAF/KMS/PrivateLink/TLS (unchanged by this chore deploy); OrdersListFn IAM is least-privilege READ-ONLY on DynamoDB (BatchGetItem/ConditionCheckItem/DescribeTable/GetItem/GetRecords/GetShardIterator/Query/Scan + kms:Decrypt/DescribeKey + xray writes; no Put/Update/Delete); order ids come from the server-side side channel (req_ctx), not parsed from model text; totals computed server-side from the fixed menu; SPA is same-origin.

EVIDENCE SUMMARY: placed order id = ORD-938274; status transitions RECEIVED->PREPARING->READY; byCreatedAt GSI IndexStatus=ACTIVE; assistant Lambda image digest = sha256:dac3a7316f47ce000a14e0e927509e80e407c0434f115cac708a4da569aba7fb; GET /api/orders JSON recorded above.
